scope: non-mutating browser observation of credential mode/origin for API-02a B1 decision

environment.cms_dev_server: pre-existing vite dev listener (vite.config.ts server.port=3005, proxy /api -> http://localhost:8000)
environment.api: pre-existing local listener http://localhost:8000 (/api/ping -> 200); step-api-node HEAD baa4f5476e22c2f2f4024d57f08d4e381a116aec
environment.browser: isolated browser profile (fresh cookie jar), real Chromium via CDP; no screenshots, no storage dumps
environment.session: synthetic local admin from step-api-node/.env TEST_ADMIN_* (values never printed, logged or stored); sign-in and sign-out executed so no session left behind
environment.instrumentation: XMLHttpRequest/fetch wrapper recording method, path, withCredentials/credentials mode, Authorization-present; CDP Network.requestWillBeSent(+ExtraInfo) for Cookie-present and Origin

observations.what: CMS login flow deposits a Better Auth httpOnly session cookie
observations.note: clean profile, so the cookie could only come from this sign-in

observations.what: authenticated reads carry Authorization AND Cookie at the same time
same_shape_seen_without_header_capture: /api/facilities (Authorization-present true, status 200, from the client probe)
observations.note: requests are same-origin to :3005 and reach the API through the vite dev proxy, so the cookie is attached even with withCredentials=false; no Origin header is sent on same-origin GET

observations.what: mutation-shaped request formed by the CMS (sign-out, auth endpoint; no domain mutation sent)
observations.note: browser attaches Origin to same-origin POST as well; mixed Cookie+Bearer is the CMS client's normal shape for fetch/XHR writes

observations.what: origin membership in both lists (source, read separately)
observations.note: read requests never exercise the CORS allowlist in dev (same-origin, no Origin header); only non-GET same-origin requests carry Origin, so the trusted list is the binding constraint for B1

proven: CMS login produces an httpOnly cookie in the same browser jar that later sends Authorization, on the same origin
every authenticated read issued by the CMS carries Cookie + Authorization + Bearer, mixed, status 200 today
http://localhost:3005 (dev) is in both CORS allowedOrigins and auth trustedOrigins
https://stepsmg.ac.id is in CORS allowedOrigins but absent from auth trustedOrigins
not_proven: no domain mutation, PATCH, preflight, or upload request was sent (B1 is a proposal; no 403 exists to observe)
production/TLS deployment: secure cookie flag, cross-site SameSite behaviour, and the production CMS->API origin pair were not exercised
no real student data, no mobile client, no DB/service/credential change; only local dev listeners that were already running were used
